name: Mermaid Sequin Costume
description: A mermaid sequin costume with a teal sequin tail and matching sequin top. Purple shell details decorate the top for a fun mermaid look.
description2: The tail is shaped to sit like a mermaid fin, with sparkle covering the costume from top to tail.

specs.fit: Fitted sequin top with a snug mermaid tail skirt
